verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item mentions n8n, Zapier, or any prebuilt no-code automation connector; the pack only covers webhooks, API clients, CLI, MCP server, and general integrations. Webhooks (apify-docs-14) could theoretically be used to build a custom integration but that is not a prebuilt connector as the story requires. Missing for 10: any documentation of official n8n/Zapier connectors, marketplace listing, or third-party integration guide.
